paragraphs.text: From the Shards of Alara set onwards, theme decks connected to expansions were referred to as intro packs , to better reflect the nature of these products. Shards of Alara has five tricolored intro packs .
Bant Exalted is a white , blue and green intro pack from Shards of Alara , focusing on exalted .
The two rares in this intro pack are Battlegrace Angel (foil) and Knight-Captain of Eos .
Esper Artifice is a blue , black and white intro pack from Shards of Alara , focusing on colored artifacts .
The two rares in this intro pack are Master of Etherium (foil) and Sharding Sphinx .
Grixis Undead is a black , blue and red intro pack from Shards of Alara , focusing on unearth .
The two rares in this intro pack are Vein Drinker (foil) and Cruel Ultimatum .
Primordial Jund is a red , green and black intro pack from Shards of Alara , focusing on devour .
The two rares in this intro pack are Flameblast Dragon ( foil ) and Mycoloth .
Naya Behemoths is a green , red and white intro pack from Shards of Alara , focusing on 5-power matters .
The two rares in this intro pack are Spearbreaker Behemoth ( foil ) and Titanic Ultimatum .
